MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Neosmuk magnetic hooks match the magnetic hanging supplies I recently bought, so their purpose feels relevant to me.",
    "The hooks connect to my interest in hanging and organizing things using magnetic attachments."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The magnetic hooks fit my interests, but I recently bought two hook sets and do not need another pack now.",
    "Test leads, splice terminals and heat shrink tubing assume a wiring project that my recent fastener and hook purchases do not establish.",
    "The adhesives and feeler gauge require specific jobs I have not shown a need for; the soap dispenser, COVID test and robot vacuum are even further from my current purpose.",
    "Ten packs of super glue would be excessive for me, especially without a specific gluing job."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop supply, even when it serves a different task.",
    "My repeated hook purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to buy more hooks immediately, even though those purchases may have met my need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent choices point more specifically toward mechanical fastening and magnetic hanging than toward electrical testing, wiring or gluing.",
    "Something can match my interests without being something I need again right now, especially after two recent purchases serving the same purpose.",
    "I rarely interact unless an item meets a clear current need; a loose connection to hardware is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in hanging hardware but stretched it into unrelated supplies and missed that I may already have enough hooks."
}
